d: Long, flowing platinum-white hair with aqua-cyan under-strands is styled with a large white bow and animal-like ears atop the head. The expression is a playful wink with one narrow crimson eye, set on a youthful, mature face. The slender build is dressed in a white and dark navy blue ensemble featuring a white bodice and puffed navy sleeves with gold accents, complemented by a red heart-shaped necklace. A small, white cat-like creature with aqua hair is perched on the chest.
